title: (tests) rangetest authz gate test matrix
description: Tests bead for the /diag/rangetest gate fixes (children worker6-16zc POST, worker6-wr8j GET-interval). Extend lichen/tests/coap_rangetest (host CMake test, pattern: stub bool lichen_coap_is_local_admin like lichen/tests/coap_config/src/main.c:146). ACCEPTANCE: cases covering (1) POST: unprotected+non-admin -> 4.01 and no provider/radio call; (2) POST: protected -> 2.05 SenML pack (Content-Format 112); (3) POST: plain+admin -> 2.05; (4) GET with interval_ms body: unprotected+non-admin -> 4.01 AND interval state unchanged AND no observer registered; (5) GET: admin sets interval (state visible on next authorized GET); (6) protected GET with Observe -> 2.05 + observer registered; (7) both Kconfig polarities if the test builds twice, else #ifdef-guard the OSCORE-protected cases per lichen/tests/coap_keys/prj.conf practice. Run: cd lichen/tests/coap_rangetest && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && cmake --build . && ctest --output-on-failure.
close_reason: Verified the full authz matrix already present at HEAD and ran it locally: west build -b qemu_x86 + ninja run, 13/13 PASS, PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL. Acceptance map: (1) POST unprotected+non-admin 4.01 + no provider call — asserted via new metrics_calls/hops_calls counters (main.c:275-278), (2) POST protected 2.05 SenML CF 112, (3) POST plain+admin 2.05 (test_post_requires_oscore_or_local_admin), (4) GET interval body unauth 4.01 + interval unchanged + no observer slot (test_get_interval_requires_authz), (5) admin interval set + visible later, (6) protected Observe GET 2.05 + observer registered (test_observe_registration_requires_authz), (7) Kconfig polarities N/A: gates are runtime checks in the always-compiled resource (CMakeLists forces CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_RANGETEST=1, OSCORE state mocked at runtime) so both polarities are exercised in one build. 3-perspective review: no P0-P2; one P3 comment-precision nit filed+fixed (8j7r).
